name: RB-S15: untouched request expires at 00:00 and is not booked
description: Leave a seed request untouched until the Timer hits 00:00. The booking is expired / unfulfilled rather than accepted.
descriptionHtml: Leave a seed request untouched until the Timer hits 00:00. The booking is expired / unfulfilled rather than accepted.
statusMessage: BLOCKED RB-S15: need a pending rental Quick Booking (L2B-RNT-*) on 9000000001 with QB Timer actively counting — prefer ≤3:00 remaining, or a fresh rental left untouched for the full real ~30:00 in one session (no relaunch; timer restarts per #28). Material MAT/MDL cards are not valid for this case.
